subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should the lifecycle owner be made available to standalone doctor resolution within this PR, or should maintainers choose and document a separate standalone activation boundary before merge?
rationale: The necessary repair is clear, but the durable owner for non-gateway lifecycle publication affects the public runtime and plugin compatibility model.

options.title: Repair doctor activation in this PR
options.body: Publish or load a complete prepared generation for the doctor path and add a fresh-process regression test before merge.

options.title: Define a separate standalone owner first
options.body: Pause this branch until maintainers specify the lifecycle owner for all non-gateway synchronous consumers.

recommendation.title: Repair doctor activation in this PR
recommendation.body: Publish or load a complete prepared generation for the doctor path and add a fresh-process regression test before merge.
